name: Rose Window
description: Gothic rose windows set in a dark wall: a wheel of twelve stained glass petals inside a pale stone ring, with a ringed jewel at the hub.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 88%, @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)) 88% 96%, transparent 96%); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 3%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-mask: @var(--rp), radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 40%, #000 40% 89%, transparent 89%); mask: @var(--rp), radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 40%, #000 40% 89%, transparent 89%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 33%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 52%, transparent 52% 70%, #000 70%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 52%, transparent 52% 70%, #000 70%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --rp: conic-gradient(from -11.16deg at 50% 50%, #000 0deg 18.6deg, transparent 18.6deg 30deg, #000 30deg 48.6deg, transparent 48.6deg 60deg, #000 60deg 78.6deg, transparent 78.6deg 90deg, #000 90deg 108.6deg, transparent 108.6deg 120deg, #000 120deg 138.6deg, transparent 138.6deg 150deg, #000 150deg 168.6deg, transparent 168.6deg 180deg, #000 180deg 198.6deg, transparent 198.6deg 210deg, #000 210deg 228.6deg, transparent 228.6deg 240deg, #000 240deg 258.6deg, transparent 258.6deg 270deg, #000 270deg 288.6deg, transparent 288.6deg 300deg, #000 300deg 318.6deg, transparent 318.6deg 330deg, #000 330deg 348.6deg, transparent 348.6deg 360deg); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
